name: adbc_connect
description: Open a driver connection from a STRUCT/MAP of options, or a named ADBC secret. Returns an opaque BIGINT handle owned by the current DuckDB client connection. Evaluate once and store the handle; URI requirements depend on the driver.

name: adbc_disconnect
description: Use CALL to close an owned connection and invalidate its handle. Returns one success BOOLEAN row. Handles are also cleaned up when their owning DuckDB client connection closes.

returnsTable.name: success
returnsTable.description: True on success; failures raise an error.

name: adbc_info
description: Return driver and server metadata for an open connection — vendor name, version strings, supported features.

name: adbc_clear_cache
description: Use CALL to invalidate schema and table metadata for attached ADBC catalogs after remote DDL. Returns cleared BOOLEAN (false if none are attached). Does not reload drivers or flush connection pools; ordinary data changes need no cache clear.

returnsTable.name: cleared
returnsTable.description: Whether attached ADBC catalog metadata was cleared.

name: adbc_scan
description: Run SQL and stream its result as a DuckDB table. Planning uses ExecuteSchema and never executes the query to infer columns. Drivers without ExecuteSchema, including SQLite, require a columns STRUCT declaring the complete ordered result schema.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: Parameter values as a STRUCT, such as row(1).

parameters.name: batch_size
parameters.description: Requested rows per batch; support depends on the driver.

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: Complete ordered result schema, such as {'id': 'BIGINT'}. Required when ExecuteSchema is unsupported.

returns: Columns follow the complete remote result schema, inferred from driver metadata or supplied with columns.

name: adbc_scan_table
description: Read a named table using GetTableSchema metadata and a generated SELECT with supported projection and filter pushdown. Supply columns to override unavailable or unsuitable metadata.
returns: Columns follow the complete remote result schema, inferred from driver metadata or supplied with columns.

name: adbc_execute
description: Use standalone CALL to execute remote DDL or DML at runtime. Returns one rows_affected BIGINT row, or NULL when unknown. PREPARE and ordinary EXPLAIN do not execute the command; EXPLAIN ANALYZE does. This function does not return query result rows.

returnsTable.name: rows_affected
returnsTable.description: Affected row count, or NULL when unknown.

name: adbc_insert
description: Pass a DuckDB query's Arrow batches to the driver's bulk ingestion API. Supported modes and transaction behavior depend on the driver.

name: adbc_commit
description: Use CALL to commit an explicit transaction after disabling autocommit. Returns success BOOLEAN.

returnsTable.name: success
returnsTable.description: True on success; failures raise an error.

name: adbc_rollback
description: Use CALL to roll back an explicit transaction. Returns success BOOLEAN.

returnsTable.name: success
returnsTable.description: True on success; failures raise an error.

name: adbc_set_autocommit
description: Use CALL to enable or disable autocommit on the owned connection. Pair false with explicit CALL adbc_commit or CALL adbc_rollback. Returns success BOOLEAN.

returnsTable.name: success
returnsTable.description: True on success; failures raise an error.

name: adbc_tables
description: List tables visible to the connection. Returns name, schema, and table type — driver-dependent filters available.

name: adbc_table_types
description: List the table-type categories the driver/server distinguishes (e.g. TABLE / VIEW / SYSTEM TABLE).

name: adbc_columns
description: Describe the columns of a table — name, type, nullability, default — pulled from the driver's catalog API.

name: adbc_schema
description: Describe a named table through the driver's GetTableSchema metadata API. The second argument is a table name, not an SQL query.

name: adbc_profiles
description: List locally discoverable ADBC connection profiles. Optionally supply additional profile search paths.
